segments.name: Warehouse
segments.description: Provides temperature-controlled warehouse storage and related handling services to food producers, processors, distributors and retailers.
segments.evidence: Our core business is our Warehouse segment, where we provide temperature-controlled warehouse storage and related handling and other warehouse services.

segments.name: Transportation
segments.description: Carries customers' temperature-sensitive products between points in the cold chain through transportation services.
segments.evidence: We view and manage our business through three primary business segments—Warehouse, Transportation and Third-Party Managed.

segments.name: Third-party managed
segments.description: Operates temperature-controlled warehouses and related functions for manufacturers and retailers in facilities they own.
segments.evidence: Our operating segments are aggregated into three reportable segments: Warehouse, Transportation, and Third-party managed.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay rent and storage fees to keep frozen and perishable food in the warehouses, plus handling and other warehouse service fees.
revenueModel.evidence: We collect rent and storage fees to store customers' frozen and perishable food and other products within our real estate portfolio.
